# stratusphere/scripts/ops/Remove-SandboxStratusphere.ps1

<!-- Generated by scripts/Update-BrainDocs.ps1 from the code. Do not edit; edit the code and regenerate. -->

Deallocates or tears down a sandbox Stratusphere UX environment, removing VNet peering on the test VM VNet first and disarming aa-avdlz-runs schedules.

Follows the peered VNet teardown order and safety conventions: - With -DeallocateOnly: stops the appliance VMs in rg-<Name>-<Environment>-stratusphere to halt the compute meter while keeping disks, VNet, peering, and Key Vault intact. - Without -DeallocateOnly: requires -DiscardLastCopy (decision 0016: never delete the last copy, even with -Force), removes the peering link on the remote test VM VNet first so no Disconnected peering is left behind, deletes rg-<Name>-<Environment>-stratusphere, and disarms any pending ssux-shutdown-<Name>-* and ssux-teardown-<Name>-* jobSchedules and schedules in aa-avdlz-runs.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `-Name` | string | no | `'ssux'` |  |
| `-Environment` | string | no | `'dev'` |  |
| `-TestVmName` | string | no | `''` |  |
| `-PeerVnetId` | string | no | `''` |  |
| `-DeallocateOnly` | switch | no |  |  |
| `-Force` | switch | no |  |  |
| `-DiscardLastCopy` | switch | no |  |  |

## Examples

```powershell
./scripts/ops/Remove-SandboxStratusphere.ps1 -DeallocateOnly
```
```powershell
./scripts/ops/Remove-SandboxStratusphere.ps1 -WhatIf -DiscardLastCopy
```
```powershell
./scripts/ops/Remove-SandboxStratusphere.ps1 -Force -DiscardLastCopy
```
